notes: Hard FAIL under the frozen 20-step fixture.
Current composition proves basic lifecycle, checkpoint/idempotent skip and waiting_approval, but same-run worker recovery fails.
No durable engine recovery, approval resume, cancel, retry loop, eligible-work movement or operator replay primitive is exposed.
Benchmark ran under VF_OFFICE_ROOT sandbox with zero production authority and zero production credentials.
Existing policy says reconcile before retry and never retry blindly.
Unknown-effect provider truth is not bound to a first-class durable effect attempt, so the hard reconciliation gate remains unproven.
Plain JSON/JSONL and Git-backed code are easy to inspect and restore.
Operational simplicity does not compensate for missing in-flight durable recovery semantics.
No separate durable runtime service is present to operate, but there is also no first-class run recovery control plane.
Incumbent receipt records all frozen steps and explicit mandatory failures.
CPU/RAM/network were explicitly unavailable for short-lived one-shot processes and remain null rather than being treated as zero.
Code rollback is Git-based and JSON/JSONL state can be copied/restored.
Rollback does not provide same-run recovery for already in-flight work; that gap is scored under fitness, not hidden by file restore.

security_findings: Mutable writes were redirected to the LAB sandbox.
Existing source reads may fall back to the checked-out repository, but benchmark writes did not target production SoTs.
operations_findings: Hard failures include recover-worker, engine recovery, approval-resume, cancel-child, retry, move, reconcile-inspect and replay-finalize.
Resource fields that could not be measured are explicitly null.
